definition.description: Persistent, revisioned evidence-based editorial assessments of industry change to compression-topic causality. One review per existing change-topic link; exclusions retained for audit. Facts reference canonical changes and primary sources. Impacts are conditional analysis, not measured claims.

row.boundary_en: A compatibility issue, not demonstrated new activation capability or gains.
row.boundary_zh: 仅给出兼容性事项，不证明新的激活量化能力或收益。
row.check_en: Identify actual calls and check quantization parameters, outputs and fallback.
row.check_zh: 定位实际 API 调用，检查量化参数、输出精度与 fallback。
row.fact_focus_en: The notes list aclnnQuantMatmul / V2 / V3 / V4 replacement with V5 under deprecated interfaces.
row.fact_focus_zh: 补丁说明列示 aclnnQuantMatmul / V2 / V3 / V4 替换为 V5，属于旧接口废弃条目。
row.impact_en: Check input types and scale handoff in affected W/A paths; unrelated Attention migrations are not activation-compression progress.
row.impact_zh: 对命中的 W/A 执行路径核对输入类型与 scale 传递；不能把 Attention 的其他接口迁移一并当作激活压缩进展。
row.relevance_en: This matters only when the activation-quantized execution path uses these APIs.
row.relevance_zh: 只有当前激活量化路径使用这些矩阵乘接口时，迁移才与本专题直接相关。
row.title_en: Legacy quantized-matmul APIs require migration
row.title_zh: 量化矩阵乘的旧接口需要迁移

row.boundary_en: A compatibility constraint, not evidence of new precision, algorithms or measured gains; verify each removal schedule.
row.boundary_zh: 这是兼容性约束，不是新位宽、新算法或精度 / 性能提升证据；删除时间按各条计划确认。
row.check_en: Locate legacy calls and check V3 types, parameters and numerical regression.
row.check_zh: 先定位旧接口调用，再核对 V3 的数据类型、参数与精度回归。
row.fact_focus_en: The 9.1.1 notes repeat the replacement of aclnnWeightQuantBatchMatmul with V3; deprecation marking began in 8.5.0.
row.fact_focus_zh: 9.1.1 补丁说明重列旧接口废弃计划：aclnnWeightQuantBatchMatmul 替换为 V3；废弃标记始于 8.5.0。
row.impact_en: If the existing path calls the legacy API, assess parameters, weight layout and dequantization when migrating to avoid execution or numerical regressions.
row.impact_zh: 如果现有权重量化路径调用旧接口，需要评估迁移对参数、权重布局和反量化处理的影响，防止升级后无法执行或结果不一致。
row.relevance_en: This concerns the matrix-multiplication execution interface for quantized weights, not calibration algorithms.
row.relevance_zh: 关联的是低比特权重执行时的矩阵乘接口，而不是权重校准算法。
row.title_en: Legacy weight-quantization kernels require API migration
row.title_zh: 权重量化算子的旧接口需要迁移

row.boundary_en: No local speed/quality measurement is established; full quantization alone does not establish persistent KV storage precision.
row.boundary_zh: 项目记录没有给出本地速度和质量；“全量化”也不能独自证明持久 KV Cache 的存储位宽。
row.check_en: Check paired versions, layouts, prefill/decode coverage and actual kernel selection.
row.check_zh: 检查配套版本、输入布局、prefill / decode 支持和实际算子命中。
row.fact_focus_en: The 2026/05 project log lists A5 MXFP8 support in fused_infer_attention_score.
row.fact_focus_zh: 项目 2026/05 记录 fused_infer_attention_score 支持 A5 MXFP8 全量化。
row.impact_en: Study low-precision Attention after verifying tagged Q/K/V types, shapes and scales; a main-branch log does not establish installed-package availability.
row.impact_zh: 可对目标 Attention 层研究低精度执行，但须先确认配套标签下 Q/K/V 类型、形状与 scale；不能按主干记录直接假设安装包已具备。
row.relevance_en: This is an Attention low-precision execution entry point, distinct from linear-layer activation quantization.
row.relevance_zh: 它提供 Attention 低精度计算的算子入口；应与线性层激活量化分开分析。
row.title_en: A5: an MXFP8 fused-Attention path
row.title_zh: A5：融合 Attention 的 MXFP8 执行路径

row.boundary_en: A main-branch fix is not stable-package availability or demonstrated memory/throughput gain.
row.boundary_zh: 主干修复不等于稳定包已发布，也不能推出显存或吞吐提升。
row.check_en: Check whether the deployed tag includes the fix and test actual non-contiguous layouts.
row.check_zh: 确认部署标签是否包含修复，并覆盖实际非连续缓存布局。
row.fact_focus_en: Main-branch change !13291 passes real strides to address computation instead of assuming contiguous layouts.
row.fact_focus_zh: 主干变更 !13291 将真实 stride 传递到地址计算，修复按连续布局寻址的问题。
row.impact_en: For that kernel with non-contiguous caches, inspect stride/layout compatibility as an integration prerequisite.
row.impact_zh: 若使用对应量化 Attention 路径和非连续缓存，需检查 stride / 布局兼容性；可作为集成前的正确性检查依据。
row.relevance_en: Low-precision KV execution relies on correct cache reads; this affects correctness, not the quantization method.
row.relevance_zh: 低精度 KV 执行依赖正确读取缓存布局；这影响结果正确性，未改变量化方法本身。
row.title_en: Quantized Attention: correct non-contiguous cache addressing
row.title_zh: 量化 Attention：非连续缓存布局的正确寻址

row.boundary_en: The main-branch interface change does not establish stable availability or all-FP8 storage.
row.boundary_zh: 该主干接口改动不能外推为稳定版本可用或全缓存 FP8。
row.check_en: Check deployed tags, main/tail dtypes, tail size and allocated buffers.
row.check_zh: 核对部署标签、主 / 尾缓存 dtype、尾块大小与缓存分配。
row.fact_focus_en: Main-branch !13087 adds tail inputs including vTailOptional; tail blocks use BF16 alongside BF16/FP8 main-cache paths.
row.fact_focus_zh: 主干 !13087 增加 vTailOptional 等尾块输入，尾块使用 BF16；主缓存路径可涉及 BF16 / FP8。
row.impact_en: Include tails, scales and extra block tables when estimating memory rather than applying one precision to every cache element.
row.impact_zh: 估算 KV 占用时应计入尾块、scale 与额外块表；不能用单一低比特位宽估算全部缓存。
row.relevance_en: Mixed main/tail precision directly affects cache representation and actual compression cost.
row.relevance_zh: 低精度主缓存与高精度尾块并存，直接影响缓存表示和真实压缩成本。
row.title_en: Quantized KV retains BF16 tail blocks
row.title_zh: 量化 KV 的尾块仍保留 BF16

row.relevance_en: The fix concerns buffers used by W8A8 execution, not a separate activation-quantization algorithm.
row.relevance_zh: 该修复涉及 W8A8 模型执行所用缓冲；不是独立的激活量化算法进展。
row.title_en: W8A8 MXFP8: buffers after reload
row.title_zh: W8A8 MXFP8：重载后的量化执行缓冲

row.impact_zh: 若流程会重载量化权重，应检查加载前后量化参数和图执行的一致性。
row.relevance_en: Reloaded quantized weights must remain consistent with captured graphs and buffers, affecting runtime correctness.
row.relevance_zh: 量化权重在重载后仍需与图捕获和缓冲区保持一致，关联的是量化模型运行正确性。
row.title_en: W8A8 MXFP8: quantized buffers during weight reload
row.title_zh: W8A8 MXFP8：权重重载时的量化缓冲修复

row.impact_zh: 可作为所列模型 / 硬件的运行基线；需确认量化权重格式与当前工具产物兼容。
row.relevance_en: W8 concerns low-precision weight loading/execution; A8 is an accompanying activation condition.
row.relevance_zh: W8 指向低精度权重的加载与执行；A8 是同时存在的激活条件。
row.title_en: MiniMax-M3: a low-precision weight runtime path
row.title_zh: MiniMax-M3：低精度权重的推理入口

row.boundary_en: Algorithm documentation does not establish support for every shape, model or device.
row.boundary_zh: 文档的算法支持不等于所有 Attention 形状、模型或芯片都能执行。
row.check_en: Check calibration, quantization axes and the actual linear/Attention kernels.
row.check_zh: 分别核对校准数据、量化轴和实际命中的线性层 / Attention 算子。
row.fact_focus_en: Official documentation separately lists weight–activation scaling and per-head INT8 Attention quantization.
row.fact_focus_zh: 官方分别列示权重—激活协同缩放与 Attention 的 per-head INT8 量化。
row.impact_en: Select calibration and quantization for the target layer rather than applying linear W8A8 settings to Attention wholesale.
row.impact_zh: 按目标层选择校准与量化配置，避免把线性层的 W8A8 配置直接套到 Attention。
row.relevance_en: One handles activation outliers; the other targets Attention activations. Their locations and execution paths differ.
row.relevance_zh: 前者处理激活离群值，后者面向 Attention 激活；压缩位置与计算路径不同，应分别比较。
row.title_en: SmoothQuant / FA3: linear-layer and Attention activation paths
row.title_zh: SmoothQuant / FA3：分别处理线性层与 Attention 激活

row.boundary_en: This is a documented internal test version with an unconfirmed publication day, not an October or stable-release claim.
row.boundary_zh: 这是文档列示的内测版；发布日期未确认，不作为十月新发布或稳定版本结论。
row.check_en: Check static/dynamic scales, sensitive-layer fallback and prefill/decode behaviour.
row.check_zh: 核对静态 / 动态 scale、敏感层回退和 prefill / decode 行为。
row.fact_focus_en: The version table lists Qwen3.5 MoE W8A8 and W4A8 for selected models.
row.fact_focus_zh: 版本表列出 Qwen3.5 MoE 的 W8A8，以及部分模型的 W4A8。
row.impact_en: Establish A8 calibration/quality baselines for listed models, then check the actual activation kernels.
row.impact_zh: 可对表中模型建立 A8 校准与质量基线，再检查运行时是否使用对应激活量化算子。
row.relevance_en: A8 explicitly concerns runtime activations, limited to the documented model–mode combinations.
row.relevance_zh: A8 明确涉及运行时激活精度，但只能对应版本表列出的模型与模式。
row.title_en: alpha02: model-specific A8 activation paths
row.title_zh: alpha02：指定模型的 A8 激活路径

row.boundary_en: This is a documented internal test version with an unconfirmed publication day, not an October or stable-release claim.
row.boundary_zh: 这是文档列示的内测版；发布日期未确认，不作为十月新发布或稳定版本结论。
row.check_en: Check model identity, per-layer W/A settings and runtime loading.
row.check_zh: 核对模型名称、具体层的 W/A 配置与引擎加载结果。
row.fact_focus_en: The version table lists W4A8 adaptations for Qwen3-Coder-480B / GLM-5.
row.fact_focus_zh: 版本表列出 Qwen3-Coder-480B / GLM-5 的 W4A8 等模型适配。
row.impact_en: Use a listed model as a tooling starting point and align its exported W4/W8 path with runtime support.
row.impact_zh: 若研究模型在表中，可据此选择工具起点；导出模型还需与推理栈支持的 W4 / W8 路径对齐。
row.relevance_en: W4/W8 specifies weight precision; A8 is an accompanying activation configuration, not weight-only quantization.
row.relevance_zh: W4 / W8 描述权重精度；A8 是同时存在的激活配置，不应混为仅权重量化。
row.title_en: alpha02: model-specific low-bit weight adaptations
row.title_zh: alpha02：指定模型的低比特权重适配

row.boundary_en: No measured tuned accuracy, tuning time or inference speedup is provided here.
row.boundary_zh: 没有给出调优后的质量提升、耗时或推理加速实测。
row.check_en: Retain calibration data, final configuration and fallback layers for reproducible comparison.
row.check_zh: 保留校准数据、最终量化配置和回退层，便于与固定配置比较。
row.fact_focus_en: alpha02 documents autotuning improvements and model_adapter extensibility.
row.fact_focus_zh: alpha02 记录自动调优优化及 model_adapter 插件化基础。
row.impact_en: Use them as tuning entry points when existing configurations miss quality targets; validate exported/runtime behaviour.
row.impact_zh: 当现有量化配置难以满足目标质量时，可用作调参入口；自定义适配仍需核对实际导出和运行。
row.relevance_en: These support integration and tuning, not a new weight-quantization method or demonstrated accuracy gain.
row.relevance_zh: 它改善接入和调参流程，本身不构成新的权重量化方法或精度收益证据。
row.title_en: Autotuning and adapters: quantization workflow support
row.title_zh: 自动调优与模型接入：量化流程的配套能力

row.boundary_en: The method name alone does not establish low precision in every layer or a particular compression ratio.
row.boundary_zh: 尚不能由算法名称推出所有层均低精度存储或特定压缩倍数。
row.check_en: Inspect actual K/V dtype, scale overhead, retained high precision and long-context quality.
row.check_zh: 查看实际 K/V dtype、scale 开销、保留高精度部分与长上下文质量。
row.fact_focus_en: Official documentation lists a dedicated KV Cache quantization method.
row.fact_focus_zh: 官方将 KVCache Quant 单独列为 KV Cache 量化方案。
row.impact_en: Use it to develop a low-precision cache candidate while aligning representation, exported parameters and runtime reads/writes.
row.impact_zh: 可用于构建低精度缓存候选方案；落地要同时对齐缓存表示、导出参数和推理引擎的读写路径。
row.relevance_en: It targets accumulated decoding state, distinct from weights and temporary Attention tensors.
row.relevance_zh: 对象是解码阶段累积的 K/V 状态，不是权重，也不只是一次 Attention 计算中的临时张量。
row.source_locator: KVCache Quant / 词条定义与适用场景
row.title_en: KVCache Quant: a persistent K/V cache path
row.title_zh: KVCache Quant：直接面向持久 K/V 缓存

row.boundary_en: Format enums are not a device/model kernel-support matrix.
row.boundary_zh: 格式枚举不是所有芯片或模型的算子支持矩阵。
row.check_en: Check activation-scale provenance, mode metadata and actual execution.
row.check_zh: 核对激活 scale 来源、模式元数据与实际量化路径。
row.fact_focus_en: compressed-tensors currently lists W8A8 Static/Dynamic; AscendV1 lists a broader set.
row.fact_focus_zh: compressed-tensors 当前列示 W8A8 Static / Dynamic；AscendV1 列示更广的模式。
row.impact_en: Align static/dynamic A8 export and execution settings for the model and runtime.
row.impact_zh: 根据目标模型与引擎确定静态 / 动态 A8，避免导出配置和执行配置不一致。
row.relevance_en: Activation quantization depends on calibrated or runtime scales, beyond the weight files.
row.relevance_zh: 激活量化除了权重文件，还依赖静态校准或运行时 scale 的解释。
row.source_locator: 量化格式 / 格式地图与三种格式如何区分
row.title_en: Static/dynamic A8 scales must match the format
row.title_zh: A8 的静态 / 动态 scale 必须与格式匹配

row.boundary_en: The format claim still requires model/cache-kernel checks.
row.boundary_zh: 格式中的支持声明仍需核对具体模型与缓存算子。
row.check_en: Check exported KV parameters, runtime dtype switches and actual cache memory.
row.check_zh: 核对导出 KV 参数、引擎 dtype 开关与实际缓存占用。
row.fact_focus_en: The table lists KV Cache modes for AscendV1; compressed-tensors currently excludes KV Cache.
row.fact_focus_zh: 格式表列示 AscendV1 的 KV Cache 模式；compressed-tensors 当前不支持 KV Cache。
row.impact_en: Use a KV-aware handoff supported by the runtime; changing weight formats does not enable low-precision caches.
row.impact_zh: 选择包含 KV 配置且目标引擎支持的交付路径；不能把换权重格式当作开启低精度缓存。
row.relevance_en: Persistent-cache quantization cannot be inferred from ordinary W8A8 weight formats.
row.relevance_zh: 持久缓存的量化配置不能由普通 W8A8 权重格式自动推出。
row.source_locator: 量化格式 / 格式地图与三种格式如何区分
row.title_en: KV quantization requires its own handoff support
row.title_zh: KV 量化需要专门的格式与加载支持

row.boundary_en: A format listing does not establish every weight method or a speedup.
row.boundary_zh: 格式支持不证明每种权重量化算法均能运行或获得加速。
row.check_en: Check runtime, exact mode, artifact files and loading logs.
row.check_zh: 核对目标框架、实际模式、权重文件与加载日志。
row.fact_focus_en: The format table distinguishes AscendV1, compressed-tensors and MindIE-SD; they are not interchangeable.
row.fact_focus_zh: 官方格式表区分 AscendV1、compressed-tensors 与 MindIE-SD；三者不能互换加载。
row.impact_en: Choose by target runtime, then inspect weights and scales/metadata; changing stacks generally requires re-export.
row.impact_zh: 先按目标引擎选格式，再检查权重与 scale / 元数据；换栈通常需要重新导出。
row.relevance_en: Weight precision, packing and metadata must be interpreted consistently downstream.
row.relevance_zh: 权重的位宽、打包和元数据必须被下游解释一致，否则算法产物无法可靠执行。
row.source_locator: 量化格式 / 格式地图与三种格式如何区分
row.title_en: Handing quantized weights to the runtime
row.title_zh: 量化权重如何交给推理引擎

row.boundary_en: This does not establish generic LLM pure-factorization deployment on Ascend.
row.boundary_zh: 不能据此认定通用 LLM 的纯低秩压缩已在昇腾落地。
row.check_en: Check model class, both branches, total storage and available fused kernels.
row.check_zh: 分别核对模型类型、两条分支的计算、总存储与可用融合算子。
row.fact_focus_en: The official table describes low-rank residuals combined with quantization, including diffusion use cases.
row.fact_focus_zh: 官方将 SVDQuant 列为低秩残差与量化组合，应用包括扩散模型。
row.impact_en: Study joint low-rank/quantization design while accounting for the extra branch alongside the low-bit main path.
row.impact_zh: 可借鉴其低秩—量化协同思路；需把低秩分支额外计算与低比特主分支一起计入成本。
row.relevance_en: The low-rank branch handles quantization error; this differs from replacing the full matrix with smaller factors.
row.relevance_zh: 低秩分支参与量化误差处理；这与用低秩因子直接替换完整权重矩阵的目标并不相同。
row.title_en: SVDQuant: an adjacent low-rank–quantization combination
row.title_zh: SVDQuant：低秩与量化组合的相邻路线

row.boundary_en: Fewer nonzeros do not establish proportional storage, bandwidth or latency reductions.
row.boundary_zh: 非零元素变少，不自动等于存储、访存或时延同比下降。
row.check_en: Check sparsity patterns, index overhead, sparse kernels and end-to-end gains.
row.check_zh: 核对稀疏模式、索引开销、稀疏算子及端到端收益。
row.fact_focus_en: The official table lists ADMM-based floating-point sparsification.
row.fact_focus_zh: 官方列示基于 ADMM 的浮点稀疏化。
row.impact_en: Study pattern–quality trade-offs; Ascend acceleration additionally requires kernels that exploit that pattern.
row.impact_zh: 可以研究稀疏模式与质量的取舍；要转化为昇腾加速，还须匹配能利用该模式的算子。
row.relevance_en: It reduces nonzero weights and belongs to weight pruning/sparsification.
row.relevance_zh: 它通过产生稀疏权重减少有效非零元素，属于权重剪枝 / 稀疏化路线。
row.title_en: Float Sparse: weight sparsification
row.title_zh: Float Sparse：权重稀疏化实现

row.boundary_en: Listed algorithms do not establish arbitrary model/precision support or locally measured quality and throughput.
row.boundary_zh: 算法列示不证明任意模型、位宽均受支持，也没有提供本地质量或吞吐收益。
row.check_en: Check weight precision, group size, export format and kernel inputs in the model recipe.
row.check_zh: 核对模型实践中的权重位宽、分组粒度、导出格式与算子输入。
row.fact_focus_en: The algorithm table lists GPTQ column-wise error compensation and AWQ activation-statistic scaling.
row.fact_focus_zh: 官方算法表列出 GPTQ 的逐列误差补偿和 AWQ 的激活统计缩放。
row.impact_en: Treat them as candidate Ascend weight-quantization tools; confirm model and precision before handing artifacts to a compatible runtime.
row.impact_zh: 可作为昇腾权重量化的候选工具路线；先确认目标模型与位宽，再把校准产物交给支持该格式的推理引擎。
row.relevance_en: These address weight-quantization error. Activation-aware calibration does not imply quantized runtime activations.
row.relevance_zh: 两者服务于权重量化的误差控制；AWQ 使用激活统计校准，不等于运行时也量化激活。
row.title_en: GPTQ / AWQ: tooling routes for low-bit weights
row.title_zh: GPTQ / AWQ：生成低比特权重的工具路线
